add.event: 恒大致广东政府的信函在网上流传，警告现金紧张，股价暴跌
add.evidence: Following widespread online sharing of a letter in August 2021, in which Evergrande warned the Guangdong government that it was at risk of experiencing a cash crunch, shares plunged

add.event: 恒大一笔离岸债券违约，惠誉宣布其“限制性违约”
add.evidence: finally defaulted on an offshore bond at the beginning of December 2021

add.event: 中植暂停几乎所有产品兑付
add.evidence: In mid-August 2023, it suspended payments on nearly all of its products

add.event: 香港法院下令清盘恒大
add.evidence: On 29 January 2024, a Hong Kong court ordered Evergrande to be liquidated.
